comment: Upstream tests that fail on the plain nightly without any patch. A failure counts as passed only when its file and full name match an entry and the patches leave that test's source unchanged. An entry is tolerated for as long as it is listed, also after it passed once (a flaky test fails again later). `status` reports the last pass and failure per machine; remove an entry once it no longer fails anywhere. See docs/machines.md, Known upstream failures.

failures.test: MessagesTimeline messages > keeps the visible sentence in a long message when the chat width changes
failures.note: Flaky, not bound to one machine, also on the plain nightly 0.1.12-nightly.20261125.5230: the sentence moves 341px instead of under 30. Fails every run on the MacBook Air (macOS 27.2.1, headless Chromium 1248); on the MacBook Pro it passed all afternoon on 2026-11-25 and failed at 23:14; devbox1 has only seen it pass.
